sanskrit: ā tū na indra kṣumantaṁ citraṁ grābhaṁ saṁ gṛbhāya | mahāhastī dakṣiṇena ||
english: Seize for us, O Indra, a splendid, bountiful prize with your great right hand.

sanskrit: vidmā hi tvā tuvikūrmiṁ tuvideṣṇaṁ tuvīmagham | tuvimātram avobhiḥ ||
english: For we know you as one of mighty deeds, of mighty gifts, of mighty wealth, of mighty measure through your help.

sanskrit: nahi tvā śūra devā na martāso ditsantam | bhīmaṁ na gāṁ vārāyante ||
english: Neither the gods nor mortal men, O hero, can hinder you when you are minded to give, terrible as a raging bull.

sanskrit: eto nv indraṁ stavāmeśānaṁ vasvaḥ svarājam | na rādhasā mardhiṣan naḥ ||
english: Come, let us now praise Indra, the self-sovereign lord of wealth; he will not fail us with his bounty.

sanskrit: pra stoṣad upa gāsiṣac chrāvat sāma gīyamānam | abhi rādhasā jugurat ||
english: He shall sing forth, he shall come near, he shall hear the Sāman being sung, he shall roar in response with his bounty.

sanskrit: ā no bhara dakṣiṇenābhi savyena pra mṛśa | indra mā no vasor nir bhāk ||
english: Bring it to us with your right hand, touch it also with your left; O Indra, do not deprive us of wealth.

sanskrit: upa kramasvā bhara dhṛṣatā dhṛṣṇo janānām | adāśūṣṭarasya vedaḥ ||
english: Step forward boldly, O bold one, and bring to us the treasure of him who has not pressed soma — him who is the more unworthy.

sanskrit: indra ya u nu te asti vājo viprebhiḥ sanitvāḥ | asmābhiḥ su taṁ sanuhi ||
english: O Indra, whatever prize of yours is to be won through inspired poets — do win it well for us.

sanskrit: sadyojuvas te vājā asmabhyaṁ viśvaścandrāḥ | vaśaiś ca makṣū jarante ||
english: Your prizes, swift as the speed of a day, all-glittering, and the willing steeds — may they come quickly at our desire.

sanskrit: ā pra drava parāvato 'rvāvataś ca vṛtrahan | madhvaḥ prati prabharmaṇi ||
english: Run forward here, O Vṛtra-slayer, from far away and from near, to the pouring out of the sweet drink.

sanskrit: tīvrāḥ somāsa ā gahi sutāso mādayiṣṇavaḥ | pibā dadhṛg yathociṣe ||
english: Come hither: the soma juices are strong and pressed, intoxicating; drink steadily as is your wont.

sanskrit: iṣā mandasvād u te araṁ varāya manyave | bhuvat ta indra śaṁ hṛde ||
english: Exhilarate yourself with food; indeed it is fit for your desire and your mood; may it be good for your heart, O Indra.

sanskrit: ā tv aśatrav ā gahi ny ukthāni ca hūyase | upame rocane divaḥ ||
english: Come, O you who have no foe, come hither; you are also invoked for the recitations in the highest luminous realm of heaven.

sanskrit: tubhyāyam adribhiḥ suto gobhiḥ śrīto madāya kam | pra soma indra hūyate ||
english: This soma, pressed for you with stones and strained through the cow-hairs for exhilaration, is called forth for you, O Indra.

sanskrit: indra śrudhi su me havam asme sutasya gomataḥ | vi pītiṁ tṛptim aśnuhi ||
english: O Indra, hear well my call; achieve the full drinking and satisfaction of our soma mixed with milk.

sanskrit: ya indra camaseṣv ā somaś camūṣu te sutaḥ | pibed asya tvam īśiṣe ||
english: That soma, O Indra, which has been pressed for you in the bowls and the cups — you are the lord of it; drink of it.

sanskrit: yo apsu candramā iva somaś camūṣu dadṛśe | pibed asya tvam īśiṣe ||
english: The soma that gleams in the cups like the moon in the waters — you are the lord of it; drink of it.

sanskrit: yaṁ te śyenaḥ padābharat tiro rajāṁsy aspṛtam | pibed asya tvam īśiṣe ||
english: That soma which the eagle bore to you with its foot through the realms of air, the untouched — you are the lord of it; drink of it.

sanskrit: devānām id avo mahat tad ā vṛṇīmahe vayam | vṛṣṇām asmabhyam ūtaye ||
english: That great help of the gods — that we choose for ourselves, the aid of the mighty bulls on our behalf.

sanskrit: te naḥ santu yujaḥ sadā varuṇo mitro aryamā | vṛdhāsaś ca pracetasaḥ ||
english: May Varuṇa, Mitra, and Aryamā always be our allies, and the wise ones who bring increase.

sanskrit: ati no viṣpitā puru naubhir apo na parṣatha | yūyam ṛtasya rathyaḥ ||
english: Bear us beyond the many widespread dangers as if across waters with ships; you are the charioteers of cosmic order.

sanskrit: vāmaṁ no astv aryaman vāmaṁ varuṇa śaṁsyam | vāmaṁ hy āvṛṇīmahe ||
english: May the excellent thing be ours, O Aryamān; excellent, O Varuṇa, worthy of praise — for it is the excellent that we choose.

sanskrit: vāmasya hi pracetasa īśānāśo riśādasaḥ | nem ādityā aghasya yat ||
english: For of the excellent are the wise, ruling, conquering Ādityas the lords; they do not lead to harm.

sanskrit: vayam id vaḥ sudānavaḥ kṣiyanto yānto adhvann ā | devā vṛdhāya hūmahe ||
english: We, whether dwelling at home or going on the road, call upon you, O bountiful gods, for increase.

sanskrit: adhi na indraiṣāṁ viṣṇo sajātyānām | itā maruto aśvinā ||
english: Watch over us, O Indra, watch over us, O Viṣṇu, as our kinsfolk; and so too the Maruts and the Aśvins.

sanskrit: pra bhrātṛtvaṁ sudānavo 'dha dvitā samānyā | mātur garbhe bharāmahe ||
english: The brotherhood of you bountiful ones — we take it up again together, even as in the mother's womb.

sanskrit: yūyaṁ hi ṣṭhā sudānava indrajyeṣṭhā abhidyavaḥ || adhā cid va uta bruve ||
english: For you are the bountiful ones with Indra as your chief, you who shine upon us — even of you, therefore, I speak.

sanskrit: preṣṭhaṁ vo atithiṁ stuṣe mitram iva priyam | agniṁ rathaṁ na vedyam ||
english: I praise your most beloved guest, dear as a friend, Agni the well-known, like a chariot.

sanskrit: kavim iva pracetasaṁ yaṁ devāso adha dvitā | ni martyeṣv ādaduḥ ||
english: The seer-like, wise one whom the gods thereafter placed a second time among mortals.

sanskrit: tvaṁ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝṁḥ pāhi śṛṇudhī giraḥ | rakṣā tokam uta tmanā ||
english: Protect, O youngest god, the men of the worshipper; hear our praises; guard his offspring and also yourself.

sanskrit: kayā te agne aṅgira ūrjo napād upastutim | varāya deva manyave ||
english: With what praise, O Agni Aṅgiras, O child of strength, shall I approach you, O god, to satisfy your will?

sanskrit: dāśema kasya manasā yajñasya sahaso yaho | kad u voca idaṁ namaḥ ||
english: With what mind shall we serve the sacrifice, O son of strength? What shall I say? — this homage here.

sanskrit: adhā tvaṁ hi nas karo viśvā asmabhyaṁ sukṣitīḥ | vājadraviṇaso giraḥ ||
english: So you shall win for us all good dwellings; our songs are full of prize-winning wealth.

sanskrit: kasya nūnam parīṇaso dhiyo jinvasi dampate | goṣātā yasya te giraḥ ||
english: Whose ample thoughts do you now quicken, O lord of the house? His hymns to you are cow-winning.

sanskrit: tam marjayanta sukratum puroyāvānam ājiṣu | sveṣu kṣayeṣu vājinam ||
english: They adorn him, the wise one who goes before in the contests, the prize-winner in his own abodes.

sanskrit: kṣeti kṣemebhiḥ sādhubhir nakir yaṁ ghnanti hanti yaḥ | agne suvīra edhate ||
english: He dwells among good, peaceful folk; none slays him, but he slays; the man of good heroes prospers, O Agni.

sanskrit: ā me havaṁ nāsatyāśvinā gachataṁ yuvam | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
english: Come both of you, O Nāsatyās, O Aśvins, to my call, for the drinking of the sweet soma.

sanskrit: imam me stomam aśvinEmam me śṛṇutaṁ havam | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
english: Hear this my laud, O Aśvins; hear this my call, for the drinking of the sweet soma.

sanskrit: ayaṁ vāṁ kṛṣṇo aśvinā havate vājinīvasū | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
english: This Kṛṣṇa calls to you both, O Aśvins, O lords of fleet steeds, for the drinking of the sweet soma.

sanskrit: śṛṇutaṁ jaritur havaṁ kṛṣṇasya stuvato narā | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
english: Hear the call of the worshipper Kṛṣṇa as he praises, O heroes, for the drinking of the sweet soma.

sanskrit: chardir yantam adābhyaṁ viprāya stuvate narā | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
english: Bring the inviolable shelter to the inspired man who praises, O heroes, for the drinking of the sweet soma.

sanskrit: gachataṁ dāśuṣo gṛham itthā stuvato aśvinā | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
english: Come to the house of the worshipper who praises you thus, O Aśvins, for the drinking of the sweet soma.

sanskrit: yuñjāthāṁ rāsabhaṁ rathe vīḍvaṅge vṛṣaṇvasū | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
english: Yoke the donkey to your firm-wheeled chariot, O you who possess bulls, for the drinking of the sweet soma.

sanskrit: trivandureṇa trivṛtā rathenā yātam aśvinā | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
english: Come with the triple-poled, triple-fastened chariot, O Aśvins, for the drinking of the sweet soma.

sanskrit: nū me giro nāsatyāśvinā prāvataṁ yuvam | madhvaḥ somasya pītaye ||
english: Now, O Nāsatyās, O Aśvins, do the two of you promote my songs, for the drinking of the sweet soma.

sanskrit: ubhā hi dasrā bhiṣajā mayobhuvo ubhā dakṣasya vacaso babhūvathuḥ | tā vāṁ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṁ sakhyā mumocatam ||
english: Both of you, O wonder-workers, are healers, bringers of joy; both of you have responded to the words of our skill. Viśvaka calls you both for the protection of his body; do not forsake our friendship — release us.

sanskrit: kathā nūnaṁ vāṁ vimanā upa stavad yuvaṁ dhiyaṁ dadathur vasyaiṣṭaye | tā vāṁ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṁ sakhyā mumocatam ||
english: How should a distracted man praise you both? Yet you have given him thought for the attainment of better things. Viśvaka calls you both for the protection of his body; do not forsake our friendship — release us.

sanskrit: yuvaṁ hi ṣmā purubhuje mam edhatuṁ viṣṇāpve dadathur vasyaiṣṭaye | tā vāṁ viśvako havate tanūkṛthe mā no vi yauṣṭaṁ sakhyā mumocatam ||
english: You two, O givers of abundance, gave this Viṣṇāpva his increase for the attainment of better things. Viśvaka calls you both for the protection of his body; do not forsake our friendship — release us.

sanskrit: uta tyaṁ vīraṁ dhanasām ṛjīṣiṇaṁ dūre cit santam avase havāmahe | yasya svādiṣṭhā sumatiḥ pitur yathā mā no vi yauṣṭaṁ sakhyā mumocatam ||
english: We call also that hero who wins wealth, who has soma-juice, though he be far away, for help; whose most sweet favour is like a father's care. Do not forsake our friendship — release us.

sanskrit: ṛtena devaḥ savitā śamāyata ṛtasya śṛṅgam urviyā vi paprathe | ṛtaṁ sāsāha mahi cit pṛtanyato mā no vi yauṣṭaṁ sakhyā mumocatam ||
english: The god Savitā rested through cosmic order; the horn of cosmic order spread out broadly; order has overcome even the great ones who fight against it. Do not forsake our friendship — release us.

sanskrit: dyumnī vāṁ stomo aśvinā krivir na seka ā gatam | madhvaḥ sutasya sa divi priyo narā pātaṁ gaurāv iveriṇe ||
english: Our glorious praise calls to you, O Aśvins, like a miller pouring — come hither; drink, O heroes beloved in heaven, of the sweet pressed juice, like two wild bulls at a pool.

sanskrit: pibataṁ gharmam madhumantam aśvinā barhiḥ sīdataṁ narā | tā mandasānā manuṣo duroṇa ā ni pātaṁ vedasā vayaḥ ||
english: Drink the hot sweet milk-drink, O Aśvins; sit upon the barhis, O heroes; gladdened in Manu's dwelling, sit down and bestow strength with your wisdom.

sanskrit: ā vāṁ viśvābhir ūtibhiḥ priyamedhā ahūṣata | tā vartir yātam upa vṛktabarhiṣo juṣṭaṁ yajñaṁ diviṣṭiṣu ||
english: The Priyamedhas have called you both with all aids; come along the path to those who have prepared the barhis, to the sacrifice made pleasing in its heavenly aspirations.

sanskrit: pibataṁ somam madhumantam aśvinā barhiḥ sīdataṁ sumat | tā vāvṛdhānā upa suṣṭutiṁ divo gantaṁ gaurāv iveriṇam ||
english: Drink the sweet soma, O Aśvins; sit with good intention upon the barhis; growing strong through the excellent praise, come from heaven like two wild bulls to a pool.

sanskrit: ā nūnaṁ yātam aśvināśvebhiḥ pruṣitapsubhiḥ | dasrā hiraṇyavartanī śubhas patī pātaṁ somam ṛtāvṛdhā ||
english: Come now, O Aśvins, with your water-sprinkling steeds; O wonder-workers of the golden track, O lords of beauty, you who strengthen cosmic order — drink the soma.

sanskrit: vayaṁ hi vāṁ havāmahe vipanyavo viprāso vājasātaye | tā valgū dasrā purudaṁsasā dhiyāśvinā śruṣṭy ā gatam ||
english: For we inspired singers call you both for the winning of the prize; come, O charming wonder-workers of many wondrous deeds, O Aśvins skilled in prayer, come in obedience to our call.

sanskrit: taṁ vo dasmam ṛtīṣahaṁ vasor mandānam andhasaḥ | abhi vatsaṁ na svaseṣu dhenava indraṁ gīrbhir navāmahe ||
english: We praise with our songs that wonder-worker of yours, who conquers in the onslaught, who rejoices in the wealth of soma-juice, even Indra — as cows lowing to their calf at their resting places.

sanskrit: dyukṣaṁ sudānuṁ taviṣībhir āvṛtaṁ giriṁ na purubhojasam | kṣumantaṁ vājaṁ śatinaṁ sahasriṇam makṣū gomantam īmahe ||
english: We desire the heavenly, bountiful one, clothed with his powers like a mountain, the giver of abundant enjoyment, the flourishing prize of hundreds, of thousands, rich in cattle — come quickly.

sanskrit: na tvā bṛhanto adrayo varanta indra vīḍavaḥ | yad ditsasi stuvate māvate vasu nakiṣ ṭad ā mināti te ||
english: Neither great mountains nor hard rocks can keep you back, O Indra; when you desire to give wealth to the praising singer of your praise, none can diminish that in you.

sanskrit: yoddhāsi kratvā śavasota daṁsanā viśvā jātābhi majmanā | ā tvāyam arka ūtaye vavartati yaṁ gotamā ajījanan ||
english: You are a warrior by wisdom, by might, and by wondrous power, surpassing all beings by your greatness; this hymn which the Gotamas have begotten turns to you for aid.

sanskrit: pra hi ririṣa ojasā divo antebhyas pari | na tvā vivyāca raja indra pārthivam anu svadhāṁ vavakṣitha ||
english: You have burst forth from the ends of heaven with your might; the earthly realm could not contain you, O Indra; you have grown according to your own nature.

sanskrit: nakiḥ pariṣṭir maghavan maghasya te yad dāśuṣe daśasyasi | asmākam bodhy ucathasya codita maṁhiṣṭho vājasātaye ||
english: There is no hindrance to your bounty, O Maghavan, when you bestow gifts on the worshipper; be stirred by our laud, O most munificent one, for the winning of the prize.

sanskrit: bṛhad indrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahaṁtamam | yena jyotir ajanayann ṛtāvṛdho devaṁ devāya jāgṛvi ||
english: Sing the great hymn to Indra, O Maruts, to the mightiest slayer of Vṛtra, through whom the strengtheners of cosmic order have generated light, the wakeful deity for the god.

sanskrit: apādhamad abhiśastīr aśastihāthendro dyumny ābhavat | devās ta indra sakhyāya yemire bṛhadbhāno marudgaṇa ||
english: He drove away the revilers, destroying those reviled; then Indra became resplendent. The gods, O Indra, with the host of Maruts, O you of great brilliance, yoked themselves to your friendship.

sanskrit: pra va indrāya bṛhate maruto brahmārcata | vṛtraṁ hanati vṛtrahā śatakratur vajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||
english: Sing forth to the great Indra, O Maruts, with your sacred formulas; the Vṛtra-slayer, the hundred-powered one, slays Vṛtra with the hundred-jointed bolt.

sanskrit: abhi pra bhara dhṛṣatā dhṛṣanmanaḥ śravaś cit te asad bṛhat | arṣantv āpo javasā vi mātaro hano vṛtraṁ jayā svaḥ ||
english: Bring forth with bold heart, O bold-minded one; may your glory be great; let the waters flow swiftly, like mothers — slay Vṛtra and win the light of heaven.

sanskrit: yaj jāyathā apūrvya maghavan vṛtrahatyāya | tat pṛthivīm aprathayaṁs tad astabhnā uta dyām ||
english: When you were born without precedent, O Maghavan, for the slaying of Vṛtra — thereby you spread out the earth; thereby you also propped up the sky.

sanskrit: tat te yajño ajāyata tad arka uta haskṛtiḥ | tad viśvam abhibhūr asi yaj jātaṁ yac ca jantvam ||
english: From that the sacrifice was born for you, from that the hymn and the praise-shout; thereby you are the overcomer of all that has been born and all that shall be born.

sanskrit: āmāsu pakvam airaya ā sūryaṁ rohayo divi | gharmaṁ na sāman tapatā suvṛktibhir juṣṭaṁ girvaṇase bṛhat ||
english: You stirred the ripe in the unripe; you raised the sun in heaven; like the gharma-vessel heat it with your songs of praise — the great hymn pleasing to the hymn-lover.

sanskrit: ā no viśvāsu havya indraḥ samatsu bhūṣatu | upa brahmāṇi savanāni vṛtrahā paramajyā ṛcīṣamaḥ ||
english: May Indra prosper us in all our callings; may the Vṛtra-slayer, supreme in might, who delights in sacred verse, attend our prayers and pressings.

sanskrit: tvaṁ dātā prathamo rādhasām asy asi satya īśānakṛt | tuvidyumnasya yujyā vṛṇīmahe putrasya śavaso mahaḥ ||
english: You are the first giver of bounties; you are the true maker of lordship; we choose for our ally the great might of the son who has exceeding glory.

sanskrit: brahmā ta indra girvaṇaḥ kriyante anatidbhutā | imā juṣasva haryaśva yojanendra yā te amānmahi ||
english: Prayers that cannot be overcome are fashioned for you, O Indra, O lover of praise; accept these, O lord of bay horses — the songs, O Indra, which we have composed for you.

sanskrit: tvaṁ hi satyo maghavann anānato vṛtrā bhūri nyṛñjase | sa tvaṁ śaviṣṭha vajrahasta dāśuṣe 'rvāñcaṁ rayim ā kṛdhi ||
english: For you, O Maghavan, are true and unbowed, and you lay low many Vṛtras; therefore, O most mighty, O thunderbolt-handed one, turn abundant wealth toward the worshipper.

sanskrit: tvam indra yaśā asy ṛjīṣī śavasas pate | tvaṁ vṛtrāṇi haṁsy apratīny eka id anuttā carṣaṇīdhṛtā ||
english: You, O Indra, are glorious, the soma-drinker, O lord of strength; you alone slay the resistless Vṛtras, unconquered, upholding the people.

sanskrit: tam u tvā nūnam asura pracetasaṁ rādho bhāgam ivemahe | mahīva kṛttiḥ śaraṇā ta indra pra te sumnā no aśnavan ||
english: And you, the wise lord, we now implore as we would implore our share of bounty; your shelter, O Indra, is like a great hide for protection; may your blessings reach us.
